title: Levels of Management Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 5
description:
Why can't one boss run a business with fifty people? In this animated lesson we picture Chai Corner a few years from now, with five outlets and fifty workers, and see why Ravi needs levels of management.

You will learn what levels of management are, what authority means, and the three levels in the management pyramid: top management (board of directors, CEO or MD), middle management (department heads and branch managers) and lower or first-line management (supervisors and foremen), plus how far ahead each level plans.

This is Episode 5 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
